'''Landing Zone I-3''' was a landing zone on the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Mercantile Plaza]] in the [[Imperial Concourse]].<ref name="TOR" />

A notice to Offworlders from the [[Order of Shasa]] at a nearby [[Droid/Legends|droid-staffed]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] stated that the number of beverages that could be bought and consumed in one visit was strictly limited. The sign also reminded visitors to always remain mindful of cultural norms, particularly as regards to maintaining a respectful distance and tone with the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] hosts.<ref name="TOR" />
